hero_tag: Empowering Global Futures through Education, Career Development & Work Support.
hero_mission: At APEX Global Talent, we bridge Sri Lankan talent with top-tier academic and professional opportunities in Japan and South Korea. As an authorized education institute and direct representative, we provide seamless, transparent, and end-to-end pathways for students and professionals aiming for global success.

who_2: We go beyond conventional language training. We offer **direct admissions**, specialized language qualification prep (**JLPT/NAT/TOPIK**), and comprehensive **career development support** backed by official institutions in Japan and South Korea.
pillar1_d: Comprehensive Japanese and Korean language instruction, exam preparation (JLPT/NAT/TOPIK), and cultural orientation.
pillar2_d: Vocational skill alignment, academic counseling, and professional capability building.
pillar3_d: Direct residency pathways, visa application guidance, and post-arrival employment & lifestyle assistance.

about_inst: APEX Global Talent is a language institute and visa advisory in Malabe, Sri Lanka. We teach Japanese and Korean and guide students through study and work pathways to Japan and South Korea, honestly and with no hidden costs.
footer_legal_text: Apex Global Talent Pvt Ltd is a registered private educational consultancy and language training institute in Sri Lanka. We provide language instruction and visa documentation guidance. We are not an embassy, consulate, or government migration authority. Final decisions regarding visa approvals, admissions, and work permits reside exclusively with the Immigration Services Agency of Japan, the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea, the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Bureau (SLBFE), and authorized educational institutions. We do not make false promises or guarantees.
footer_bio: Sri Lanka's trusted educational institute and visa consultancy specializing in certified Japanese (JLPT, NAT) and Korean (EPS-TOPIK, TOPIK) instruction, and ethical immigration documentation for study & work opportunities.
courses_title: Certified Language Courses for Every Goal
courses_desc: Choose your language track below. All courses feature printed materials, certified instructors, mock exam series, and official study certificates for visa processing.
courses_note: All courses include certified printed study materials, audio files, past exam papers, and an official 150+ hours study certificate required by Japanese & Korean Immigration authorities.
visa_desc: From your first inquiry in Sri Lanka to your first steps in Japan or South Korea, our transparent 5-step process keeps you guided, prepared, and confident.
visa_s1_desc: One-on-one session at our Colombo office or online. We evaluate your G.C.E. O/L & A/L qualifications, financial sponsor feasibility, and determine the optimal visa category (Student, SSW, or EPS).
visa_s1_tip: Understand genuine costs, timelines, and legal criteria with zero false promises.
visa_s2_desc: Begin your certified Japanese (JLPT/NAT) or Korean (EPS/TOPIK) batches. Simultaneously, our documentation specialists guide you through gathering attested certificates, affidavits, and bank proofs.
visa_s2_tip: Every document is audited against Japanese & Korean Immigration verification rules.
visa_s3_desc: Your verified package is submitted directly to the accredited Japanese language school, university, or Korean admissions office for screening and Certificate of Eligibility (COE) submission.
visa_s3_tip: We maintain direct tracking and communication with Japanese & Korean partner bodies.
visa_s4_desc: Upon receiving the original COE from immigration authorities, we assist with tuition settlement and lodging the visa application with the Embassy of Japan or Republic of Korea in Sri Lanka.
visa_s4_tip: Thorough mock interview coaching guarantees confident consular submission.
visa_s5_desc: Attend our detailed pre-departure briefing covering airport immigration protocols, student accommodation/dormitory check-in, part-time work legal limits, and local SIM/banking setups.
visa_s5_tip: Continuous post-arrival guidance with established alumni in Tokyo, Osaka & Seoul.
